author: alefe
quote: Absolute the worst GTA game by far, made a fun franchise into a movie game like those Sony titles, limiting players freedom and actions into a slog of a intro that takes over 10 hours doing garbage chores for Lucia, making a GTA feel like a novel where the protagonist is a cuck sitting in a chair. Gaming with horrendous performance issues, not only is only 30 FPS on the PS5 Pro, but also dips to even lower not to mention the amount of bugs. This is truly a game made for jounalist and the "modern audience". Game tries so hard to be RDR2, but even in that regard it fails miserable thanks to the tone shift between the "realism" and the normal gameplay of a average GTA game, can't believe they take 13 years for this joke **** to come out and be praise like it's the best game of the generation
